content.description: Based on customer feedback, we are reworking Captivate to feature its own unique world and story in a Fantasy setting. This version of Captivate will be our flagship product, and we will see you all on Kickstarter when we are ready to launch. Captivate: Cardano Edition has been released as a print-on-demand product through The Game Crafter, and the print & play version is available here . Captivate is a fast-paced tabletop card game of strategy, skill, and memory for 2-4 players.
